sections.voiceover: Turkish police just nailed crypto founder Richard Heart in Istanbul with a shocking arrest.
Finnish authorities tracked Richard James Schueler through an Interpol Red Notice. Investigators linked him to a massive tax fraud scheme. Where did 280 million euros disappear?
Authorities raided his luxury hideout during the Istanbul operation, except they found even more.
Officers seized 64 luxury watches from the suspect. Turkish authorities confiscated 4 million dollars in cash on site. Finnish authorities are seeking Richard James Schueler over the missing funds.
Interpol warrants tracked 280 million euros across borders.
